scandals.value: In July 2025 the Patriotic Alliance suspended Kunene after he was present at a private home when police arrested its owner in a murder investigation. Kunene said he had accompanied a journalist from his publication to arrange an interview. He resigned from the council pending an external review.
scandals.label: Reported
scandals.outcome: A report by law firm Cliffe Dekker Hofmeyr found no evidence refuting Kunene's account and said it was not aware of any criminal or civil proceedings against him related to his presence (M&G, 23 September 2025). The PA reinstated him and he was sworn in again as a councillor on 26 September 2025 (EWN).
